'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Brian Billetta LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Billetta]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Blue Milk. Brian Billetta, 2014 Worlds, 2010 form. Unread reserve lines: 59.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
